subject: RECORD DELIMITER clause
notes: The general format is implemented EXACTLY as printed, and the printed page was rendered rather than inherited from the transcription (kb/Work PB292): RECORD, DELIMITER and STANDARD-1 are underlined (required words), IS is not (an optional word), feature-name-1 is a user-defined word, and the braces are a plain required choice of exactly one alternative with no choice indicators. `recordDelimiterClause : RECORD DELIMITER IS? (STANDARD_1 | cobolWord)` is that diagram one-for-one. All FOUR legal spellings are exercised by the golden and each draws the clause's named decline: STANDARD-1 with IS (file F1), feature-name-1 with IS (F2), STANDARD-1 with the optional word omitted (F3); the complement, a file with no clause at all (F4), draws none. The format row is CONFORMS rather than DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT because the syntax IS accepted here — §4.2.6 licenses accepting a declined processor-dependent element and only compels the warning, unlike Annex A.4.1, which forbids accepting an unclaimed OPTIONAL element's syntax (the A.4.8 FORMAT rows are DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT for that reason).
